name: Habitat for Humanity International
summary: Builds, repairs and finances homes with low-income families through about 984 US affiliates and national organisations in more than 60 countries; buyers repay affordable mortgages.

programs.label: US affiliates: homes built and sold, repairs and disaster recovery
programs.weight_source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): U.S. affiliates programme services $184,691 thousand, less about $2 million of US advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json). Public awareness and education ($24,292 thousand, with the advocacy booked in the other lines) is modelled in evaluation/unpublished/habitat-for-humanity/, held back until a review finds no high finding.

programs.label: International programme: housing with national organisations and market development
programs.weight_source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): international affiliates programme services $75,514 thousand, less about $1.5 million of Home Equals advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json).
